title: Create Master MAM Group
precondition: User registered with Money Manager permissions.
steps: 1. Open MAM Manager Portal.2. Create new MAM group 'FX Alpha Pro'.3. Select default allocation method: Proportional by Balance (PBB).4. Bind master MT5/FIX trading account.
expected_result: MAM group initialized in DB; status set to 'Active'; master trading terminal connected; unique Group ID assigned.
actual_result: MAM Master initialized in DB. client_id: mem_e2dbce29e1c71a7bf6, display_name: mammaster, status: active
